impact: The scandal is widening into export-control politics, raising the odds of tighter China chip curbs that would hit NVDA and spill into MU, DRAM and SNXX.
summary: Senior White House officials have discussed whether Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick should be pushed out over the Nvidia China-chip scandal, Reuters reported citing two people familiar. Senate Banking Chairman Tim Scott asked Jensen Huang to testify Dec. 3 and Lutnick, who has agreed to appear, on Dec. 10; Scott said he would consider subpoenaing Huang. House chairs separately want Huang and Nvidia's general counsel for closed-door interviews on Dec. 1 and 2.
title: White House weighs Lutnick ouster; Senate calls Huang, Lutnick to testify
